## File: facebookresearch_llama/llama/generation.py

Prompts

```
['build a Llama instance by loading a pre-trained model from checkpoint files and tokenizer', 'generate text sequences from tokenized prompts using nucleus sampling with temperature and top-p controls', 'complete a list of text prompts using the Llama model with configurable temperature and top-p sampling', 'generate assistant responses for conversational dialogs with system, user, and assistant message roles', 'sample tokens from a probability distribution using top-p nucleus sampling with a given threshold', 'build a Llama Transformer model with ModelArgs config and run a forward pass on token tensors', 'create an RMSNorm normalization layer with a given dimension and epsilon for numerical stability', 'run precompute_freqs_cis to generate complex exponential frequency tensors for rotary embeddings', 'apply rotary embeddings to query and key tensors using precomputed frequency cis values', 'review the Attention module with multi-head attention, KV caching, and grouped query attention support', 'initialize a Tokenizer instance with a SentencePiece model file path', 'encode a string into a list of token IDs with optional BOS and EOS tokens', 'decode a list of token IDs back into a human-readable string', 'review the Tokenizer class and its SentencePiece-based encoding and decoding methods', 'summarize the Tokenizer API including encode, decode, and special token ID attributes']
```

Usage

```
{'build_llama_model': 'build a Llama instance by loading a pre-trained model from checkpoint files and tokenizer', 'generate_text_from_prompts': 'generate text sequences from tokenized prompts using nucleus sampling with temperature and top-p controls', 'complete_text_prompts': 'complete a list of text prompts using the Llama model with configurable temperature and top-p sampling', 'chat_completion_dialogs': 'generate assistant responses for conversational dialogs with system, user, and assistant message roles', 'sample_top_p_tokens': 'sample tokens from a probability distribution using top-p nucleus sampling with a given threshold'}
```
